book.name: 2 Koronti
book.title: Pwoo ɗevǝl dǝ Pool ran nen Koronti mo

content: Pool Kǝ JeplepMu Ɗung Mo
Wen canciin nǝ, wu ngung kǝ wen mbǝ rep mwen fen sǝ. Kussuk wu gung kǝ wen!
Wen kǝn cìn zuur nkaa wun mbǝ Naan. Wun a kaa reep nuk ɗe baa war kǝ man mish kas. Wen kǝn tuweerpwoo mbǝ shin wun nɗyik, kaa matpoo sǝ pee mish war ɗe, a Kristi wur a mish fuu nǝ.
Amma wen kǝn kǝǝr, taji nǝ yool ɗee a kaa gyet nwoo gwam Iif shi seen wur ɗe mu ɗung sǝ kas. Taji mo yool gwam wun, kǝ mo mer kǝ pan fuu mo nkaa wal ɗeret, ɗe wun kǝ nǝ mbǝ Kristi kas.

A mii le ɗang katɗang mee gurum jì satpwoo nkaa mee Jesu ɗe ɗyík kǝ pwoo ɗe mun mu sat nǝ nwun bǝ wuu kǝlǝng pwoo mǝnǝ yi? Wu pan nǝ riin mǝnǝ ɗyík kǝ Riin Naan ɗe wuu kat nǝ yi? Kǝ wu pan nǝ, mee pwoo Naan nǝ ɗe ɗyik waa met pwoo Naan ɗe wuu lap nǝ yi?
Wen man azeen nǝ, baa wen a ɗekat met jir nɗǝǝn jeplep nǝ mo kas.
Meeɓe, baa wen man satpwoo rǝret kas, amma wen man satpwoo ɗeret nǝ. Muu kám man nǝ nwun agaak koo a pǝrangyi mɓut mbii mo jir.
Tan, gyet wen cìn a mbii ɗebish, mbǝɗe gyet wen sham kǝ káa fen, mbǝkǝ Naan wur ɗiyeep wun ɗi kaaɗe wen satpwoo kǝ Naan nǝ nwun shi zuum sǝ wa?
Wen lap ɓam pǝ pak Ekǝlisya mo, mbǝkǝ wen cìn ɗak ɗi nnaar fuu. Wen mak sat nǝ, gyet wen ghǝr a long fur mo, mbǝkǝ wen ɓam wun ɗi.

Kaaɗe gyet wen ɗe ashak kǝ wun, bǝ baa gyet wen kǝ mee mbii kas, kǝzak, baa gyet wen lejeel mmee gurum kas. Mbǝɗe ɗyemnǝǝn fun ɗe mo tong mMasidoniya jì ɗi, a mo jì shin wen mbii ɗe wen kǝn reɓet mo. A mbǝmǝnǝ, ɗangɓe koo a nɗǝǝn ar ɗeɗangyi, ɓe baa wen le mee jeel wun kas. Kaaɗe baa gyet wen lejeel wun kas sǝ.
Mbǝɗe wen man nǝ, pwoo ɗe wen kǝn sat nǝ a pwoo mǝ Kristi azeen, ɓe baa mee ngwe mak cíi canjoom nwen nɗǝǝn yil Akaya kas.
A mii le ɗang wen sat kǝsǝ yi? A mbǝɗe baa wen wal nwun kas aa? Naan wur man nǝ, wen wal nwun zam.
Ɗak ɗe wen nkaa cìn nǝ, ɓe wen sat a ncìn a nǝ, mbǝkǝ wen shootpwoo mu canjoom ɗi jeplep ɗe moo sat nǝ, ɗak fur nǝ a nciit kǝ munu.
Kaan kǝ nen mǝnǝ mo a jeplep mu ɗung mo. Moo cìn a ɗak ɗe mu numpee mo. Moo lekáa fur kaa mo a jeplep mu Kristi mo sǝ, ɗang baa mo a jeplep Kristi kas.
Baa nǝ ɗee a mbii aapwoo kas, mbǝɗe koo a Gujwan shikáa wur, bǝ wur leshin kaa wur a ngulep mu peeɓang sǝ.
Mbǝmǝnǝ ɓe baa nǝ ɗee a mbii aapwoo kas, katɗang bǝ kǝrem mu Gujwan mo lesut fur, kaa mo a nen cìn ɗak ɗeret mo sǝ zak. A peekyes nǝ, ɓe mon nlap kwat fur mo nciit kǝ ɗak fur mo zak.
Pool Shwaajeel mBǝƊee a Ngulep Jesu
Wen kǝn baa sat ɗi zak nǝ, taji mee gurum pan nǝ, wen a mwen kas. Amma katɗang wu pan nǝ, wen a mwen, ɓe wu lap wen ɗesǝ kaa mwen nǝ sǝ, mbǝkǝ wen kat pee can rep joom ɗi lee.
Pwoo ɗe wen sat sǝ, ɓe baa wen sat a mee pwoo ɗe Daa wur lep wen kas, amma wen kǝn satpwoo nǝ a kaa mwen sǝ, wen kǝn sat pwoo mǝnǝ a tyap.
Kaaɗe gurum mo ɗes moo can a joom ɗe mu yil ɗesǝ ɓejee ɗak sǝ, ɓe wen ncanjoom nǝ akǝsǝ zak.
Wun nen ɗe wu seen ɓe wu gung kǝ nenmwen mo shi retnyit.
Mbǝɗe katɗang, ɓe mee gurum le wun kaa kǝrem mo sǝ, koo wur ghǝǝr wun, koo wur se lǝɓet nkaa wun, kǝ koo wur kám a ɓal mu tuur nwun, kǝ koo wur nǝnas wun, jir kǝsǝ ɓe wuu gung kǝ ngwe mǝnǝ.
Nǝ shweep wen mbǝ lap ii, nǝ gyet mun kǝ ɓal mbǝ cìn mbii ɗesǝ mo kas, amma katɗang mee gurum kǝ canjoom nkaa mee mbii, ɓe wen kǝn satpwoo nǝ a kaa mwen sǝ. Wen ncanjoom akǝsǝ zak.
Katɗang ɓǝ, mo a nen Hiburu mo, bǝ wen a ngu Hiburu zak. Katɗang ɓe, mo a nen Izrel mo, ɓe wen a ngu Izrel zak. Katɗang ɓe mo a ɗang kǝ Abraham, ɓe wen a ɗang kǝ Abraham zak.

Katɗang ɓe mo a kǝrem mu Kristi mo, ɓe wen a kǝrem mu Kristi zak. Wen satpwoo nǝ a kaa ngutar sǝ! Mbǝɗe wen cìn ɗak ɗe nǝ ɗes met mumo nǝ. Mo kǝ ɓwoot wen le nlushoot, kǝ wen shwaanas met mǝ sat zak. Wen kǝn shwaajeel mo shinǝ-shinǝ har kus kǝ muut zak.
Gyet yit paat, ɓe nen Yahudi mo fwo ngwoor nwen laarkun baapwoofeer.
Nennan-nan mu Rom mo sǝrem wen shi gwoor yitkun. Nen Yahudi mo car wen shi nding yit mǝndong, mbǝkǝ mo tu wen ɗi. Yitkun ɓe tii am, nǝ taa pyan kǝ mun. Wen kǝn cam teer kǝ wet nkaa am bahar.

Shidaar-shidaar bǝ wen a ar mwaan mo ɗes, kǝ nwen kǝn naa muut shi yit fen mɓut ndung mo. Wen kǝn naa muut nsar kǝ nenwat mo, kǝ nwen naa muut nsar kǝ ɗang fun nǝ Yahudi mo zak. Wen kǝ naa muut nsar kǝ nenkum mo. Wen kǝn naa muut nɗǝǝn yilkaam mo, kǝzak, wen kǝn naa muut a naaryil mo. Wen kǝ naa muut nkaa am bahar mo. Wen kǝn naa muut nsar kǝ ɗyemnǝǝn ɗe mu ɗung mo.
Wen kǝn shwaaɗak mo, kǝ wen kǝn shwaajeel mo, kǝn nnaa nteer mmeen, kǝ wen kǝ shwaaneen zak, kǝ neen am tu wen zak. Yit mo ɗes baa wen kat mee mbiise kas. Wen kǝn shwaakut, mbǝ ciin mbiisǝp,
kǝ pak mbii mo ɗes ɗe kǝzak. Mbii ɗe mo daampee nwen, koo puus ɗeɗangyi, nǝ a mbǝɗe wen kǝ toon mǝ tap kǝ Ekǝlisya mo jir zak.
Katɗang baa mee ngwe katɓal kas, ɓe nǝ le kǝ baa wen katɓal kas zak. Katɗang mee ngwe taa pal nɗǝǝn shikbish, ɓe nǝ shwal nwen zam.
Katɗang bǝ nǝ a tǝng kǝ wen canjoom, ɓe wen canjoom nǝ a nkaa mbii ɗe nǝn nkám agaak nǝ baa wen kǝ ɓal kas,
Naan puun kǝ Daa Jesu ɗe sǝm wur nǝ kat ɗeret har ngaa-ngaa. Wur man azeen-nzeen nǝ, baa wen kǝn sat a ɗung kas.
Nɗǝǝn yil nDamaskus, ɓe gofna ɗewur ndir kǝ mishkoom Aritas wur shootpwoo sheep pǝbong ɗin nDamaskus mo, mbǝkǝ mo yaa wen ɗi.
Mo le wen sham nɗǝǝn kǝci ɗeɗes mmee fung mu fwang mu yilkaam nǝ, har wen put nkoom nsar wur.
